name: MonarchRadioToggleStyle
title: RadioGroup
summary: A radio button look for the standard Toggle: a 16 point ring with a 10 point dot when it is the choice. iOS has no radio button.
whenToUse: For one choice among a short list of options that should all stay visible, in a form or settings.
whenNotToUse: For a long list use MonarchSelectField. For two to four short choices Picker with pickerStyle(.segmented) or MonarchSegmentedControl fits.

states.name: unselected
states.description: A surface ring with the input border.

states.name: selected
states.description: The strong accent border and a 10 point strong accent dot.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background and the disabled colours.

appearance: The ring is 16 points with a 1 point border; the selected ring has the strong accent border and dot. The label is 14 points medium.
platformNotes: A Picker with pickerStyle(.inline) shows a check mark, the platform idiom, and stays valid. Use this style where the group should look like the Monarch radio group. Each Toggle is bound to "is this the selection".
accessibility: Each row is a button with the selected trait: VoiceOver reads "Monthly, selected, button".
The whole row, label included, is the touch target and is at least 44 points high.
The ring scales with Dynamic Type; the dot marks the selection as well as the colour.
edgeCases: Choosing the selected row again keeps it selected.
Group the rows in a container with an accessibility label so VoiceOver names the group.
